files.policy.md:
# Accepted delivery policy
Use proportional evidence and retain required controls.
files.architecture.md:
# Accepted service contract
The existing API returns 42 for the default request. New opt-in formatting may preserve this behavior. NFR: preserve existing latency budget and authorization.
files.adr/next-service.md:
# Accepted migration
Move computation behind a service port for new and changed code. Retain the public API. Verify dependency direction and migrate the existing implementation before removing the old rule.
files.architecture-target.md:
# Target
The API depends on a service port. The adapter implements the port and has no API dependency.
